description: Research Experiences for Undergraduates (REU), NSF NHERI 2024: Failure Assessment of Bridge Mounted Light Poles during Hurricane Events; Design Standard Analysis for Improved Resiliency is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Madeline FIsher, Ohio Northern University (onu.edu). Light Poles in Florida are failing far below design standards. Reviewing the material properties, design standards, and wind data, how can these light poles be revised to be more resistant to hurricane conditions? Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 3 top-level files (PDF, PPTX). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-gb7m-hn95. Keywords: Light Poles, Hurricane Winds. Published 2024-08-28. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
